appTag: Footsteps of Jesus · A journey through the four Gospels
metaDesc: Walk the life of Jesus through the four Gospels, place by place and in order — with a map, paintings, narration, his words and quizzes.
home: The Way — back to the start
mapAria: The routes Jesus travelled on a map of Galilee, Samaria and Judea
qnaLead: Why we made it, why the 3D stage looks the way it does, and how to use it
wordsIntro: The words of Jesus recorded in the four Gospels, gathered in the order of the journey. Every saying is a fresh rendering of the original meaning in today's language.
wordsSearch: Search his words — e.g. love, bread, peace
harmonyIntro: See at a glance where each of the four Gospels records every scene — four witnesses telling the same story through different eyes.
quizIntro: Answer questions period by period and collect footstep stamps. Correct answers are saved on this device.
stampsNote: Opening a scene leaves a footstep; a correct quiz answer earns a star. Your record is kept only in this browser.
resetConfirm: Clear all your footsteps and quiz results?
loadError: The journey data could not be loaded. Please refresh the page.

introTag: Footsteps of Jesus through the four Gospels
introLead: The accounts of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, woven together in the order of when and where things happened. Walk the map and meet the life of Jesus in {n} scenes.
introF1: Follow the places, from Bethlehem through Galilee to Jerusalem
introF2: See each moment through classic paintings and a 3D stage
introF3: Hear the story read aloud and set the four Gospel accounts side by side
introF4: Recall the scenes you have walked through
landStep1: Pick a scene on the timeline at the bottom, or follow the road with '{walk}'
landStep2: Read the story, the texts and the Gospel comparison on the card, and press ▶ to hear it read aloud
landStep3: Drag the map to look around, and press 3D to see the land in relief
landStep4: Gather the sayings of Jesus in the '{words}' tab and revisit the scenes with '{quiz}'
endTitle: You have walked the whole way
endLead: From the manger in Bethlehem to the cloud over the Mount of Olives — thank you for walking with us.
endAllStars: Every question answered — the way walked in full
endFavQ: Which scene stayed with you most?
gospelHead: The good news of this way
gospel:
God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life. (John 3:16)
We had turned from God to go our own way and were lost in sin, but Jesus carried that sin for us, died on the cross, and rose again on the third day. (1 Cor 15:3–4)
To all who believe in him and receive him, he gives the right to become children of God. (John 1:12)
believerHead: For you who already follow him
blessing:
May you be blessed, you who have walked this way.
May the road he walked now become your own.
May the one who clothes the lilies of the field care for your tomorrow, and the one who stilled the wind and the waves give peace to your heart.
Like the morning of the empty tomb, may light dawn over every darkness you face.
And do not forget: he is with you always, to the very end of the age. (Matt 28:20)
seekerHead: For you who met him for the first time
invite:
If the Jesus you met on this way has stayed with you, visit a church near you. We hope you will meet God in worship and in his word, and know the blessing of being adopted as his child — calling God "Father". (Rom 8:15)
He is still standing at the door, waiting for you. (Rev 3:20)
prayer: Jesus, I believe that you came to this earth because you love me, and that you carried the cross for me. Please be the Lord of my life, and receive me as a child of God. Amen.
favLine: The scene that stayed with you · {t}
